title: Recording: Deliver Your Children, Morse Moose And The Grey Goose by Wings | 1977
content:
Fair Carol, St John, US Virgin Islands
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Geoff Emerick, Mark Vigars

Wings continued recording ‘Deliver Your Children’ and ‘Morse Moose And The Grey Goose’ for the London Town album on 19 May 1977.

The session took place aboard the Fair Carol, a 105-foot yacht kitted out with studio equipment from the Record Plant in New York. It was moored in Waterlemon Bay, St John, in the US Virgin Islands.

Both songs had been started the previous day. This session began with Denny Laine double-tracking his lead vocals for ‘Deliver Your Children’, followed by harmonies by Laine and Paul McCartney.

The rest of the session was devoted to ‘Morse Moose’, the first part of the album’s final track. On this and the following day, McCartney added bass guitar, Joe English overdubbed drums, and Laine and Jimmy McCulloch recorded guitar parts.
